content: Predicting the price direction rather than the volatility was the focus in BIBREF23 . They extracted sentiment words from Twitter posts to build a time series of collective Profile of Mood States (POMS). Their results show that collective mood accurately predicts the direction of Down Jones stock index (86.7% accuracy). In BIBREF24 handcrafted text representations including term count, noun-phrase tags and extracted named entities are employed for predicting stock market direction using Support Vector Machine (SVM). An extension of Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) is proposed in BIBREF25 to learn a joint latent space of topics and sentiments.
